evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

step_2_no_cost_modifier_exists.claim: Syndra has no cost-reduction / cost-scaling mechanic, so a timeline entry's resource_cost must be a literal table entry.
step_2_no_cost_modifier_exists.check: Full cached prose for P Transcendent, Q, W, E, R was read. The only mana interaction is the passive's REFUND ('Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores 20 : 255 (based on level) mana') and a W note ('Throwing the [Blue Sentinel] will refund 10 mana'). Neither alters a cast's posted cost. No Transcendent threshold (40/60/80/100/120) touches cost.

step_3_rank_configuration.canonical_golden_config: level 18, rank 5 / R rank 3 (the repo's standing fight config, quoted verbatim in data/worklists/e4-task-1.md and e5-task-1.md)
step_3_rank_configuration.consequence: At the canonical config the value 100 is reachable only as W (rank 5) or R (any rank); the value 50 is reachable only as E (any rank). Q at rank 5 is 60, so 50 cannot be a Q cast here, and no rank of any slot other than W/R yields 100. Therefore the 50 -> 100 move is NOT a numeric re-pricing of one ability - the slot occupying cast_timeline[2] changed identity (or the timeline gained a preceding entry).

step_4_which_slot_belongs_at_index_2.default_order: data/worklists/f2-task.md: 'src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R)' - explicitly framed as the naive fallback. Under that fixed order the third cast (index 2) is E, cost 50 == the OLD value exactly.
step_4_which_slot_belongs_at_index_2.scenario_name: The scenario is named 'syndra_custom_order_120'. 'custom_order' is the fight's caller-supplied cast_order (the same receipt field seen for Vladimir in data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json: 'Q 176/W 330/R 385 with cast_order R,Q,W,E'). A custom-order scenario whose index 2 coincides with the DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER's index 2 is a scenario that exercises nothing - the old value is precisely the default-order artifact.
step_4_which_slot_belongs_at_index_2.splinters_120_forces_an_extra_Q_cast: The '120' is the splinters option. data/champions.json Syndra Q: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' data/champion-audit/batch-6.json confirms the module carries a synthetic Q2 slot for it ('modeled: P, Q, Q2, W, E, R ... ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'), and batch-e9-1.json: 'splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'. At 120 splinters the second Dark Sphere charge is unconditionally available, so a full-rotation timeline is [Q, Q2, W, E, R], not [Q, W, E, R]. Index 2 is then W.
step_4_which_slot_belongs_at_index_2.cost_at_index_2: W Force of Will at rank 5 = 100 mana. (If instead the custom order places R third, R = 100 at every rank - the same answer.) Only E at index 2 yields 50, and E-at-index-2 is exactly the Q2-less, default-ordered timeline.

quoted_sources.use: W Force of Will mana cost by rank; rank 5 = 100.
R Unleashed Power mana cost = 100 at every rank.
E Scatter the Weak = 50 at every rank - the only Syndra ability that can produce the old value at the canonical rank config.
Q = 60 at rank 5, so 50 is not a Q cast at level 18; rules out the 'Q at rank 3' reading of the old value.

quoted_sources.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
quoted_sources.use: At splinters=120 the second Q charge exists, so the rotation carries an extra Q cast ahead of W.

quoted_sources.use: The only mana term in the passive is a refund and the 120 threshold is an AP buff - neither modifies a cast's resource_cost.

quoted_sources.use: Confirms the Q2 slot and that 120 is the splinters option value named in the scenario id.

src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R).
quoted_sources.use: The old value 50 is exactly the third cast of this fixed fallback order (E), i.e. the value a scenario gets when its custom order is not in force.
Establishes that a per-fight custom cast_order is a real, supported input - what 'custom_order' in the scenario id names.

quoted_sources.use: The repo's canonical fight config, fixing the legal cost set to {Q:60, W:100, E:50, R:100}.

quoted_sources.quote: (no rule for ability resource cost; grep for 'resource|mana|cast_timeline|cast order' returns only an unrelated cast-order tiebreak note at line 66 and a BIS-score row at line 476)
quoted_sources.use: Confirms there is no derived formula for resource_cost - it is a straight table lookup, so the cached cost table is the whole authority.

residual_uncertainty.note: The scenario's literal cast_order lives in scripts/ (golden_snapshot), which this runbook forbids reading, so the slot at index 2 was inferred, not read.
residual_uncertainty.why_the_inference_is_still_decisive: Every reading available from the cached data puts W (rank 5) or R at the third cast and both cost 100: (a) splinters=120 unlocks the Q2 charge, making the rotation [Q, Q2, W, E, R] with W third; (b) a scenario explicitly named 'custom_order' is by construction not the fixed Q,W,E,R order whose third cast is E. The old value 50 is reachable only as E at index 2 - which is precisely the DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER artifact that this scenario exists to displace, and which also drops the Q2 charge the 120-splinter option guarantees.
residual_uncertainty.falsifier: If the scenario's declared cast_order literally places E third (e.g. 'W,Q,E,R'), the old value would be right. Nothing in data/ supports that ordering, and it would make the scenario's index-2 leaf indistinguishable from the default order.
